account_valid.name: account_valid
account_valid.value: identifier_kind IN ('bank_account','promptpay') AND identifier_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND length(identifier_ciphertext)>0 AND key_version>0 AND length(bank_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(masked_account) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND state IN ('active','archived') AND version>0 AND ((state='active' AND archived_at IS NULL AND archived_expires_at IS NULL) OR (state='archived' AND archived_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_expires_at>archived_at AND archived_expires_at<=archived_at+interval '8760 hours'))

activity_valid.name: activity_valid
activity_valid.value: NOT(bill_id IS NOT NULL AND occurrence_id IS NOT NULL) AND (confirmation_id IS NULL OR bill_id IS NOT NULL)

activities_history.name: activities_history
activities_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

attempt_valid.name: attempt_valid
attempt_valid.value: amount_satang BETWEEN 1 AND 900000000000 AND version>0 AND created_at<reservation_until AND reservation_until<=expires_at AND ((method='cash' AND status IN ('awaiting_confirmation','confirmed','rejected','cancelled')) OR (method='transfer' AND status IN ('awaiting_upload','verifying','pending_verification','needs_attention','cancelled'))) AND (status NOT IN ('confirmed','rejected','cancelled') OR reservation_released_at IS NOT NULL)

attempts_history.name: attempts_history
attempts_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

bills_history.name: bills_history
bills_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

bill_valid.name: bill_valid
bill_valid.value: total_satang BETWEEN 1 AND 900000000000 AND currency='THB' AND length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND status IN ('draft','open','settled','voided') AND version>0 AND (emoji IS NULL OR length(emoji)<=8)

challenge_valid.name: challenge_valid
challenge_valid.value: provider IN ('google','apple') AND proof_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '5 minutes'

completion_events_history.name: completion_events_history
completion_events_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

confirmations_history.name: confirmations_history
confirmations_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

house_valid.name: house_valid
house_valid.value: length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND state IN ('active','archived') AND version>0

idempotency_valid.name: idempotency_valid
idempotency_valid.value: key_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND length(route_scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND (replay_until IS NULL OR replay_until<=created_at+interval '5 minutes')

idempotency_history.name: idempotency_history
idempotency_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

identity_valid.name: identity_valid
identity_valid.value: provider IN ('google','apple') AND length(issuer) BETWEEN 1 AND 512 AND length(subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 512

invitations_history.name: invitations_history
invitations_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

invite_valid.name: invite_valid
invite_valid.value: token_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND expires_at<=created_at+interval '168 hours' AND ((consumed_at IS NULL)=(consumed_by_user_id IS NULL))

member_valid.name: member_valid
member_valid.value: role IN ('owner','member') AND state IN ('active','left','removed') AND version>0 AND ((state='active' AND left_at IS NULL AND archived_expires_at IS NULL) OR (state<>'active' AND left_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_expires_at>left_at AND archived_expires_at<=left_at+interval '8760 hours'))

occurrence_valid.name: occurrence_valid
occurrence_valid.value: version>0 AND length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND status IN ('pending','completed','cancelled') AND ((schedule_id IS NULL)=(schedule_revision IS NULL)) AND ((status='completed')=(completed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (status<>'completed' OR assignee_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

occurrences_history.name: occurrences_history
occurrences_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

revision_valid.name: revision_valid
revision_valid.value: revision>0 AND length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND mode IN ('repeat','rotation') AND frequency IN ('daily','weekly') AND anchor_date<=start_date AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date>=start_date) AND weekdays <@ ARRAY[0,1,2,3,4,5,6] AND ((frequency='daily' AND cardinality(weekdays)=0) OR (frequency='weekly' AND cardinality(weekdays)>0))

schedule_valid.name: schedule_valid
schedule_valid.value: version>0 AND active_revision>0 AND state IN ('active','archived')

session_valid.name: session_valid
session_valid.value: generation>0 AND access_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND refresh_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND created_at<expires_at AND expires_at<=refresh_expires_at AND refresh_expires_at<=created_at+interval '8760 hours'

share_valid.name: share_valid
share_valid.value: basis_points BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND (amount_satang IS NULL OR amount_satang BETWEEN 0 AND 900000000000) AND (NOT self_covered OR amount_satang IS NOT NULL)

shares_history.name: shares_history
shares_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

snapshots_history.name: snapshots_history
snapshots_history.value: created_at < expires_at AND expires_at <= retention_deadline_at - interval '24 hours' AND retention_deadline_at <= created_at + interval '8760 hours'

user_valid.name: user_valid
user_valid.value: length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND locale IN ('th','en') AND state IN ('active','deletion_pending')
